Rusty Launcher Lite is a standalone, privacy-conscious app launcher. It shows only apps that publish a normal launchable front door. Search, favorites, tags, and Wi-Fi launch requirements stay locally on this headset.

It does not require Developer Mode, ADB, Accessibility, a PC, an account, or a companion app. It never changes Wi-Fi itself; unmet requirements open Android Wi-Fi settings for you.

The separate full Rusty Kiosk is optional and adds advanced lab workflows when installed independently.
